next_steps.action: Measure the adapter/battery voltage reaching the standby controller's VIN. Confirm the adapter itself is good and the DC jack / input MOSFETs are passing it.

measure.what: Adapter input voltage at the standby controller VIN
measure.where: Standby controller VIN pin or the main input inductor pad
measure.expected: Adapter nominal (typically 19-20 V) OR battery nominal (typically 12.6 V for 3S Li-Ion).
measure.safety: Adapter rails can carry 19 V at several amps. Probe carefully; a slip can short to ground and burn the probe.

interpretations.then: Input supply is good. Proceed to check standby controller VCC (logic supply).
Adapter / DC jack / input MOSFET / fuse path is open. Check the DC jack voltage first, then the input fuse, then the input MOSFET gate drive. A dead charger IC can keep the input MOSFET off.

next_steps.requires_info_note: Need the standby controller datasheet for VIN pin and expected voltage.
